notes: RECORDED CONTRACT for the catalog MCP server (T-023, SPEC A1/C6).
Replayed by ingest.adapters.catalog_mcp.RecordedMCPSession, which refuses any call
it has no recording for - so `make verify` can never start making a live call, and a
contract test cannot pass by asking for something nobody recorded.
Recorded with limit=2 so pagination is exercised in four products rather
than in four hundred; construct the adapter with page_size=2 to replay it.
A tool-level failure. An MCP error result carries its explanation in the SAME
`content` field a successful one carries data in, so this recording is what
proves the decoder checks `isError` before it reaches for the payload.
